scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentpack/runtime build && node --watch src/main.ts
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentpack/runtime build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @openmanager/protocol build && pnpm --filter @agentpack/runtime build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/convergence/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:convergence:nightly: pnpm build && vitest run -c vitest.convergence.config.ts --mode nightly
